Title: UI clipping and off-screen overflow on 768p and 720p laptop screens
RootCause: Fixed pixel dimensions exceeding compact viewport WorkArea
Resolution: Implemented dynamic WorkArea detection with LayoutTransform auto-scaling down to 0.80x and constrained modal dialog MaxWidth/MaxHeight

Title: Online Search Apps button did not open dedicated modal
RootCause: Feature was originally integrated directly into main window catalog
Resolution: Created dedicated search online modal with live Winget querying and unified table styling

Title: Remove All Software button cluttered custom pack editor bar
RootCause: Legacy button remained in pack editing toolbar
Resolution: Removed button and matched Edit Pack table design style with All Applications catalog

Title: Top Choice pack icon lacked distinct visual identity
RootCause: Shared generic folder icon with standard roles
Resolution: Assigned distinct amber star icon and isolated card styling

Title: Affiliate and direct download tags leaked in catalog UI
RootCause: Internal catalog taxonomy displayed raw tag chips
Resolution: Cleaned chip rendering to strictly hide affiliate/direct taxonomy

Title: Right-side author credit color contrast mismatch
RootCause: Previous styling used generic theme foreground
Resolution: Updated Love Malhotra credit text color to #5f6d84

Title: Automated process launch failed with Win32 Error 50 in headless execution
RootCause: Start-Process relied on ShellExecuteEx which fails without interactive desktop
Resolution: Migrated test runner scripts to direct CreateProcessW via ProcessStartInfo

Title: CreateProcessW failed with Win32 Error 740 (Elevation Required)
RootCause: Embedded requireAdministrator manifest prevented non-elevated test automation
Resolution: Set __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker environment variable inside test process harness

Title: PSInvalidOperationException in concurrent Task.WaitAll verification
RootCause: PowerShell scriptblocks require Runspace TLS context unavailable on ThreadPool
Resolution: Replaced scriptblock delegate with native Task.Delay concurrency tasks

Title: Role preset group count failed on recommended_apps.json schema
RootCause: Test inspected recommended_apps.json which uses singular group rather than groups array
Resolution: Updated FUNC-003 test to inspect data/apps.json groups collection
